headline: Colombia seeks to resume natural gas imports from Venezuela via pipeline
summary: Colombia aims to recover natural gas imports from Venezuela through the reactivation of the inactive Antonio Ricaurte pipeline by mid-2027.
why: Energy infrastructure projects between neighboring countries impact regional energy supplies and cross-border trade dynamics.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Resuming cross-border gas pipeline flows alters energy sourcing and supply security for Colombia.
